Is UPVC better than aluminium for Janakpur bedrooms?

For bedrooms facing the highway, bazaar or temple traffic, UPVC with double glazing is the better choice in Janakpur’s hot Terai climate — it cuts noise, blocks heat, and needs no yearly painting. Aluminium is better for slim shopfronts and large commercial spans.
